tools.name: bookboost_list_users
tools.description: List guest profiles (users) in Bookboost. Filter by email, phone, booking reference or last update. Returns data, links and meta. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/users.

tools.name: bookboost_get_user
tools.description: Get one guest profile (user) by uuid, including names, contact fields, tags and counts. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/users/{uuid}.

tools.name: bookboost_list_user_emails
tools.description: List the email addresses stored for one guest (user), with their type. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/user/{user_uuid}/emails.

tools.name: bookboost_list_user_phones
tools.description: List the phone numbers stored for one guest (user), with their type. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/user/{user_uuid}/phones.

tools.name: bookboost_list_user_addresses
tools.description: List the postal addresses stored for one guest (user). Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/user/{user_uuid}/addresses.

tools.name: bookboost_list_user_loyalty_memberships
tools.description: List the loyalty program memberships of one guest (user), with level and expiry. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/user/{user_uuid}/loyalty-memberships.

tools.name: bookboost_list_reservations
tools.description: List reservations. Filter by guest uuid, booking reference, external reference, stay dates or last update. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/reservations.

tools.name: bookboost_get_reservation
tools.description: Get one reservation by uuid, including dates, status, party size and property. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/reservations/{uuid}.

tools.name: bookboost_create_reservation
tools.description: Create a reservation for a booking reference with stay dates and a status. Creates a new record; it does not check for duplicates. Bookboost API: POST /api/v1/reservations.

tools.name: bookboost_update_reservation
tools.description: Change fields of one reservation, such as status, dates or party size. Only the fields you pass are sent. Bookboost API: PUT /api/v1/reservations/{uuid}.

tools.name: bookboost_create_user
tools.description: Create a guest profile (user) with a primary email and phone. Creates a new record; Bookboost may reject an existing email. Bookboost API: POST /api/v1/users.

tools.name: bookboost_update_user
tools.description: Change fields of one guest profile (user). Only the fields you pass are sent. Bookboost API: PUT /api/v1/users/{uuid}.

tools.name: bookboost_list_user_lists
tools.description: List the user lists (segments of guests) in Bookboost. Filter by name. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/users-list.

tools.name: bookboost_get_user_list
tools.description: Get one user list by uuid. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/users-list/{uuid}.

tools.name: bookboost_list_user_tags
tools.description: List the tags used to label guests in Bookboost. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/user-tags.

tools.name: bookboost_list_loyalty_programs
tools.description: List the loyalty programs in Bookboost, with their levels. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/loyalty-program.

tools.name: bookboost_get_loyalty_program
tools.description: Get one loyalty program by uuid, including its levels and info. Bookboost API: GET /api/v1/loyalty-program/{uuid}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bookboost_list_users, bookboost_list_user_emails, bookboost_create_reservation · Private data: bookboost_get_user, bookboost_create_reservation, bookboost_create_user · Public sink: bookboost_list_users, bookboost_list_user_emails, bookboost_create_reservation, bookboost_create_user.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bookboost_list_users, bookboost_list_user_emails, bookboost_create_reservation · Private data: bookboost_get_user, bookboost_create_reservation, bookboost_create_user · Public sink: bookboost_list_users, bookboost_list_user_emails, bookboost_create_reservation, bookboost_create_user

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
